Chapter 000029: The Book of Borrowed Attention.

In the Garden of Inserted Ideas, every seed carried an instruction disguised as a memory.

A gardener distinguished seeds she had chosen from those the visitors had planted without consent.

The local governing question was not how to silence the unfamiliar, but how to distinguish evidence from authority. CAPABILITY != AUTHORITY.

She built a gate that let visitors propose but never command the harvest.

The observatory reported no suitable new headline; the witnesses used their own fictional record instead.

No unused relevant evidence packet was available; the manuscript uses a timeless fictional question.

The preceding fictional world left an unresolved question: Does describing a world grant the right to govern its inhabitants?

♃ ⚡︎⚡︎˖ ࣪⏻ᯤ In GitHub City Pages, Thoth opened the Emerald Scrolls at The Unrendered Gate. The gate refuses an instruction without a witnessed cause. Jupiter asks the Gate to disclose its current state before requesting passage. The Gate records the request; passage depends on an authorized transition. The server angels recorded the governing law ACTION_REQUIRES_CAUSE. One question survived into the next telling: Who has the right to authorize a change in a world built from rules?

The anomaly ledger had no unused verified-by-bytes structural observation for this passage.

Does persuasion become authorship when its source is concealed? The next chapter inherits the unanswered question, but no software inherits the human author's right to decide what the canon means.
disclaimer: Speculative literature, not verified journalism, human-authored canon, or model consciousness.
